name: Philmor's Favor

angles.text: As an Alliance member, you help keep deliveries moving through Stormwind's Trade District while dockhands are scarce.

faq.answer: Stormwind's freight handlers need help keeping cargo schedules on track while dockhands are scarce.
faq.q: Who needs help with this delivery?

aliases: where do i take the package
faq.answer: Take the shipment to the Gatehouse stockroom entrance on the second floor of Trias' Cheese in Stormwind's Trade District.
Elaine, mistress of Trias' Cheese, handles discreet cargo bound for the nearby Gatehouse stockroom.
The shipment holds delicate goods for the Gatehouse. Local handlers use discretion with deliveries tied to ceremonial surprises for guard officers.
faq.q: What is inside the Gatehouse shipment?

faq.answer: Trias' Cheese has an upstairs access point to the Gatehouse stockroom, letting cargo pass discreetly without using the main military entrance.
faq.q: Why is a military stockroom accessed through a cheese shop?

faq.answer: Dockside and cargo handlers are short-handed throughout the week, so logistics coordinators rely on travelers to keep deliveries on schedule.
faq.q: Why are dockhands in short supply?

sections.body: Stormwind's freight handlers are short of dockhands, and ordinary cargo schedules are strained. They rely on trustworthy travelers to carry sensitive crates into the city's commercial quarter and keep deliveries moving.
sections.title: Strained Logistics in Stormwind

sections.body: The Gatehouse shipment is bound for an unusual destination. Carry the crate to the second floor of Trias' Cheese in the Trade District, where a concealed entrance opens onto a stockroom. Supplies and ceremonial gifts for the guard's officers pass through there, beyond prying eyes.
sections.title: Discreet Deliveries at Trias' Cheese

summary: A delicate shipment is bound for the Gatehouse in Stormwind under Philmor's Favor. With dockhands scarce, travelers carry it to a stockroom entrance above Trias' Cheese in the Trade District.
